'''Phobium Squad''' was an off-the books team of [[InterStellar Regulators]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]] the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]] employed Phobium Squad to hold the local workers in [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquake]] shelters on [[Perekta Mesa]].<ref name="TOR" />
